description:
You are a neurosurgical resident preparing a pre-operative imaging documentation package. The CT Cranium DICOM series is already loaded in InVesalius 3. The imaging protocol is described in /home/ga/Documents/imaging_protocol.txt and output images should be saved to /home/ga/Documents/surgical_views/ (directory already created).

Create a complete anatomical documentation package:
1. Create a bone segmentation mask using appropriate Hounsfield thresholds for bone
2. Generate the 3D bone surface mesh
3. Capture 3D screenshots from three standard anatomical orientations and save them:
   - Anterior (front-facing, normed view) → /home/ga/Documents/surgical_views/anterior_view.png
   - Left lateral (side-facing) view → /home/ga/Documents/surgical_views/lateral_view.png
   - Superior (top-down, cranial) view → /home/ga/Documents/surgical_views/superior_view.png
4. Place at least 3 linear measurements on the CT slice views documenting cranial dimensions (e.g., transverse, anteroposterior, and height)
5. Save the complete project (with bone mask, surface, and all measurements) to /home/ga/Documents/surgical_views/skull_study.inv3
